newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - ING Barings initiates Disco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ING Barings initiates Disco.

text.p: -- ING Barings analyst Tadd Chessen said he initiated coverage of Argentina's supermarket chain Disco SA as a "hold."
-- Chessen said Disco, the leading supermarket chain in Argentina, has "solid fundamentals and an attractive industry outlook."
-- Chessen has a year end price target of $36 on Disco's ADRs, compared with its current price level of 31 5/8.
-- EPS is forecast at $0.47 in 1996, $0.50 this year and $0.60 in 1998.

-- "We are confident Disco will continue to successfully grow the business even in its intensely competitive industry, but we believe Disco shares are fully valued at these levels," said Chessen in a statement.
